description: This file contains the Category model class for the OpenCart admin system, responsible for managing categories including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving category data from the database. It implements operations such as adding descriptions, paths, filters, stores, layouts, and handling SEO URLs.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Model class for managing category data including CRUD operations, hierarchical path management, filters, store associations, layout settings, and SEO URL management in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category in the database with associated descriptions, paths, filters, stores, SEO URLs, and layout settings, then returns the new category ID.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Edits an existing category's main data, descriptions, hierarchy paths, SEO URLs, filters, store associations, and layout configurations.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled or disabled) of a specified category.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category and all related data including descriptions, paths, filters, stores, layouts, associated products, coupons, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: repairCategories
methods.description: Repairs hierarchical category paths starting from a given parent ID, fixing any inconsistencies.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific category, including its concatenated path.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches a list of categories based on provided filtering and sorting criteria.

methods.name: getTotalCategories
methods.description: Returns the total count of categories matching specific filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Creates a new description record for a category in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records for a specific category.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes category descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all description records for a category, indexed by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all category descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a hierarchical path record for a category.

methods.name: deletePaths
methods.description: Removes all path records for a specific category.

methods.name: deletePathsByLevel
methods.description: Removes path records for a category at levels below a given threshold.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the category’s path based on path IDs.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves all path records for a category, ordered by level.

methods.name: getPathsByPathId
methods.description: Fetches path records associated with a specific path ID.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Associates a filter with a category.

methods.name: deleteFilters
methods.description: Removes all filters associated with a category.

methods.name: deleteFiltersByFilterId
methods.description: Deletes filter associations by filter ID.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Fetches all filter IDs associated with a category.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a store with a category.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a category.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all category-store associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all stores associated with a category.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Sets the layout for a category in a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes layout associations for a category.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all category-layout associations for a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all category-layout associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout configurations for a category.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many categories use a specific layout.
